mentions.name: Tech-augmented coaching business
mentions.description: This project converts a pure services coaching business into a coaching offering augmented by technology, keeping human coaches front and center while simplifying operations and using tech/AI to support both clients and coaches.
mentions.problem: A pure services coaching business carries heavy manual operations that technology and AI can help simplify.
mentions.audience: Coaching clients and the coaches themselves
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working to convert a pure services coaching business into a coaching augmented by technology. I want to keep the human coaches front and center but simplify operations and have tech/AI fill in where it helps both the clients and the coaches.

evidence.value: I’m working to convert a pure services coaching business into a coaching augmented by technology. I want to keep the human coaches front and center but simplify operations and have tech/AI fill in where it helps both the clients and the coaches.
evidence.author: mguerville
